## Equations of different genotypes

Each genotype has its own equation, with coefficients estimated from the 31 trajectories of that genotype. The sparse models (STLSQ) of all genotypes, fitted to all years, give genotype-specific growth coefficients $\hat{\boldsymbol{\xi}}_g$. Growth rate along the mean weather path, for every genotype (grey) and for the genotypes with the lowest, median and highest final biomass:

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## Python

```python
def fit_genotype(g):
    design = make_design(Theta, tr, g)
    return fit_stlsq(design.Theta, design.dy)

coefs = pd.DataFrame({g: fit_genotype(g) for g in tr.genotypes},
                     index=["1"] + Theta.terms)
```

:::

```{r}
#| label: 07-1-run
#| echo: false
fit_genotype <- function(g) {
    design <- make_design(Theta, tr, g)
    fit_stlsq(design$Theta, design$dy)
}
coefs <- sapply(tr$genotypes, fit_genotype)
```

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## Python

```python
highlighted = ["g194", "g114", "g048"]    # lowest, median, highest final biomass
mean_path = Theta.array.mean(axis=0)
b = coefs.to_numpy()
rate = pd.DataFrame(b[0] + mean_path @ b[1:], columns=coefs.columns)
rate["das"] = np.arange(len(rate)) + tr.das0
rate = rate[rate["das"] <= 155]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 2.8))
ax.plot(rate["das"], rate.drop(columns="das"), color=GREY, lw=0.2)
for g, colour in zip(highlighted, [BURGUNDY, CYAN, BLUE]):
    ax.plot(rate["das"], rate[g], color=colour, lw=1.2, label=g)
ax.legend(frameon=False)
ax.set_xlabel("days after sowing")
ax.set_ylabel("growth rate (t/ha/day)")
fig.tight_layout()
```

:::

```{r}
#| label: 07-2-run
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
highlighted <- c("g194", "g114", "g048") # lowest, median, highest final biomass
mean_path <- cbind(1, apply(Theta, c(2, 3), mean))
das <- 1:nrow(mean_path) + tr$das0 - 1
rates <- data.frame(
    das = rep(das, ncol(coefs)),
    genotype = rep(colnames(coefs), each = length(das)),
    rate = as.vector(mean_path %*% coefs)
)
rates <- rates[rates$das <= 155, ]

ggplot(rates, aes(das, rate, group = genotype)) +
    geom_line(colour = "#D1D5DB", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_line(
        data = rates[rates$genotype %in% highlighted, ],
        aes(colour = genotype), linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_colour_dgxe("burgundy", "cyan", "blue") +
    labs(x = "days after sowing", y = "growth rate (t/ha/day)") +
    theme_dgxe() +
    legend_top()
```


## Trajectories of the selected genotypes

Biomass trajectories predicted for the three genotypes in three years, together with the APSIM trajectories. Each year is predicted by the model of the genotype fitted to the other years (leave-one-year-out, step 5).

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

```{r}
#| label: 07-3
#| ref.label: [07-3-show, 07-3-run]
#| eval: false
```

## Python

```python
P = cross_validate(Theta, tr, fit_stlsq)
years = [1984, 1998, 2008]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 3, sharex=True, sharey=True, figsize=(7.2, 6))
for col, (g, colour) in enumerate(zip(highlighted, [BURGUNDY, CYAN, BLUE])):
    i = list(tr.genotypes).index(g)
    for row, year in enumerate(years):
        s = list(tr.years).index(year)
        n = tr.nend[i, s] + 1
        days = np.arange(n) + tr.das0
        ax = axes[row, col]
        ax.plot(days, tr.Y[i, s, :n], color=colour, lw=3, alpha=0.3,
                label="APSIM")
        ax.plot(days, P[i, s, :n], color=colour, lw=1, label="model")
        if row == 0:
            ax.set_title(g, loc="left")
        if col == 0:
            ax.set_ylabel(year)
axes[0, 0].legend(frameon=False)
fig.supxlabel("days after sowing")
fig.supylabel("biomass (t/ha)")
fig.tight_layout()
```

```{r}
#| label: 07-3-run
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5.6
years <- c(1984, 1998, 2008)
trajectories <- do.call(rbind, lapply(highlighted, function(g) {
    i <- match(g, tr$genotypes)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(years, function(year) {
        s <- match(year, tr$years)
        n <- tr$nend[i, s] + 1
        data.frame(
            genotype = g, year = year, das = 1:n + tr$das0 - 1,
            source = rep(c("APSIM", "model"), each = n),
            biomass = c(tr$Y[i, s, 1:n], P[i, s, 1:n])
        )
    }))
}))
trajectories$genotype <- factor(trajectories$genotype, highlighted)

ggplot(
    trajectories,
    aes(das, biomass, colour = genotype, linewidth = source, alpha = source)
) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_grid(year ~ genotype) +
    scale_colour_dgxe("burgundy", "cyan", "blue") +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(APSIM = 2.2, model = 0.6)) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(APSIM = 0.35, model = 1)) +
    guides(colour = "none") +
    labs(x = "days after sowing", y = "biomass (t/ha)") +
    theme_dgxe() +
    legend_top()
```


## Exploring the ranking

Predicted against APSIM biomass of the 199 genotypes in one year on one day, for the sparse model. Red points are the true top 10%.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
d3 = window.d3
Plot = window.Plot
rank = FileAttachment("data/interactive/ranking.json").json()
contentWidth = contentWidthGenerator(Generators)
viewof year3 = slider("Year", rank.years, rank.years.indexOf(1998))
viewof day = slider("Day after sowing", rank.days, rank.days.indexOf(113))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const obs = rank.observed[year3][day];
  const ranks = a => {
    const order = d3.range(a.length).sort((i, j) => a[i] - a[j]);
    const r = new Array(a.length);
    order.forEach((i, k) => r[i] = k);
    return r;
  };
  const spearman = (a, b) => d3.mean(d3.zip(ranks(a), ranks(b)),
    ([x, y]) => (x - (a.length - 1) / 2) * (y - (a.length - 1) / 2))
    / ((a.length ** 2 - 1) / 12);
  const top = a => new Set(d3.range(a.length).sort((i, j) => a[j] - a[i])
    .slice(0, Math.round(0.1 * a.length)));
  const side = Math.min(contentWidth, 480);
  const panel = key => {
    const pred = rank[key][year3][day];
    const best = top(obs), chosen = top(pred);
    const overlap = [...best].filter(i => chosen.has(i)).length / best.size;
    const rows = obs.map((o, i) => ({obs: o, pred: pred[i], best: best.has(i)}));
    const [lo, hi] = d3.extent([...obs, ...pred]);
    const plot = Plot.plot({
      width: side, height: side, marginLeft: 45,
      x: {domain: [lo, hi], label: "APSIM biomass (t/ha)"},
      y: {domain: [lo, hi], label: "predicted (t/ha)"},
      marks: [Plot.line([[lo, lo], [hi, hi]], {stroke: "#9CA3AF"}),
              Plot.dot(rows, {x: "obs", y: "pred", r: 2.5, fillOpacity: 0.7,
                fill: d => d.best ? "#8B1E3F" : "#014E81"})]
    });
    return html`<div>${plot}<p class="interactive-note">Spearman ρ = ${spearman(obs, pred).toFixed(2)}, top-10% overlap ${overlap.toFixed(2)}</p></div>`;
  };
  return html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem">${panel("model")}</div>`;
}
```
